positive_global_styles: cinematic string ensemble score with a soft felt piano melody on top
cellos, violas and violins in long bowed notes
a distant muted horn joins at the peak
emotional, hopeful, fragile, worn and human

positive_local_styles: hushed low strings, slow and patient, under speech
a gradual, steadily rising build over the whole section: more players join, the line climbs
tension resolving into hope, an emotional crescendo still held back
the emotional peak: the full string section swells and lands on a warm open major chord
the warm major harmony is held and carried, gently moving, full but calm
the piano melody returns softly over sustained strings, hopeful, unhurried
a final soft resolution that decays quickly to complete silence
